description: Conservative, reversible source-backed pilot: generate all 92 numeric result pages; index at most one numeric value page per direction on a confirmed custom-domain build. The other 77 remain usable, noindex, and omitted from the sitemap. No assumptions about actual search clicks or Google indexing.
source: research/semrush-us-600.tsv / source-backed approved V2 seed dataset; competitor estimates are not ExactUnit traffic.
selectionMethod: One per directional cluster from previously approved 26-URL candidate list, preferring higher source competitor estimated keyword traffic, then lower KD. This is a release-risk control, not a ranking forecast.
